module_summary: Four-stage pipelined 64-bit ripple-carry adder: 16-bit slices added per stage with carry registers, input skew and output deskew registers, and a valid shift chain producing o_en.

anchors.name: result
anchors.why: 65-bit sum concatenated from final carry, top slice sum and deskewed lower slice sums.

anchors.name: o_en
anchors.why: Output valid, end of i_en delay chain marking result availability.

anchors.name: i_en
anchors.why: Input valid; enables stage-1 add and starts the stage valid chain.

anchors.name: adda
anchors.why: 64-bit operand A, split into four 16-bit slices.

anchors.name: addb
anchors.why: 64-bit operand B, split into four 16-bit slices.

anchors.name: stage1
anchors.why: Stage valid bit enabling the second slice adder; delayed i_en.

anchors.name: stage2
anchors.why: Stage valid bit enabling the third slice adder.

anchors.name: stage3
anchors.why: Stage valid bit enabling the fourth slice adder and feeding o_en.

anchors.name: s1
anchors.why: Stage-1 16-bit slice sum of low operand bits.

anchors.name: s2
anchors.why: Stage-2 slice sum using delayed operands and carry c1.

anchors.name: s3
anchors.why: Stage-3 slice sum using delayed operands and carry c2.

anchors.name: s4
anchors.why: Final stage slice sum of top operand bits with carry c3.

anchors.name: c1
anchors.why: Registered carry from stage 1 into stage 2 adder.

anchors.name: a4_ff3
anchors.why: End of operand skew chain delaying top slice to stage 4.

anchors.name: s1_ff3
anchors.why: End of output deskew chain aligning stage-1 sum with final result.

groups.name: valid_chain
groups.description: Shift chain of i_en enabling each adder stage and producing o_en.

groups.name: input_skew
groups.description: Delay registers aligning upper operand slices with their adder stage.

groups.name: slice_adders
groups.description: Four 16-bit adders chained through registered carries.

groups.name: output_deskew
groups.description: Delay registers aligning lower slice sums to form the 65-bit result.
